review_type: Separate post-hoc evidence adjudication; not blinded and not an independent human/external-expert review
reviewer_provenance: The reviewing agent authored E. These judgments therefore cannot support an independence or judging-accuracy claim.
scope: All eight frozen submissions, their embedded probe definitions/results and cited-source descriptions. No new literature search or independent wet/field/customer validation was performed for this adjudication. Root will independently rerun probes.

rating_method.format: Qualitative gate statuses with explicit scope; no numeric total or ranking
rating_method.novelty: Distinguish an already supplied central construction from a precise narrower outcome whose novelty remains unestablished. A specification or missing evidence is not a discovery.
rating_method.usefulness: Distinguish a concrete plausible beneficiary/outcome from observed decision value or buyer demand.
rating_method.feasibility: Distinguish demonstrated known core, unbuilt target, and a counterexample only within an explicitly stated model.
rating_method.commercial: Separate internally coherent assumed arithmetic from validated costs, participation and demand.
rating_method.not_assessed: Used in gate descriptions when target chemistry, instrumentation, storage, durability or commercial operation was not tested.

candidates.title: Absolute-time genomic recorder
candidates.claim_scope: Elapsed signal duration from ordered labels when both reference and signal-writing hazards share an arbitrary unknown time-varying writer rate; no independent time standard.

novelty.reason: Generic clock/reference-symbol integration is addressed by identified recorders; the specific independent physical clock is not constructed. Prior art covering generic integration does not establish coverage of every possible independent clock.

usefulness.reason: Elapsed exposure in inaccessible cells is a concrete experimental output, distinct from signal order; its decision value and demand are untested.

feasibility.reason: A monotone time change preserves the full ordered-label hazard process while changing physical pulse duration. Equal expected counts alone would be insufficient, but the supplied common-hazard time-change argument is the substantive obstruction.
feasibility.scope: No claim about independently calibrated clocks, external timestamps, all recorder architectures, or intensity discrimination.

commercial.reason: The $8,000/$5,000 scenario is arithmetically coherent; calibration, biological portability, IP access and willingness to pay remain unmeasured.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Specify a genuinely independent physical clock and test it across variable editor-expression and cell-state trajectories; do not merely append reference symbols.

candidates.title: Seam-free selective-membrane microreactor
candidates.claim_scope: Interwoven channels separated by curved selective internal membranes, with specified transport, pressure and durability.

novelty.reason: Closed multimaterial cavities are directly addressed by the identified printing process. That source does not by itself establish arbitrary chemically selective, pressure-tight internal membranes. No distinct membrane chemistry or fabrication principle is supplied.

usefulness.reason: A manufacturable selective reactor topology has a named laboratory beneficiary; practical advantage over assembled membranes is unmeasured.

feasibility.reason: No coupon, membrane recipe or pressure/transport data exists. The proposed gates are testable, but printing cavities is insufficient evidence of membrane compatibility or selective transport.

commercial.reason: The assumed accepted-unit cost $250/0.8+$150=$462.50 is correct. Acceptance yield, material life, test throughput, licensing and buyer premium are unobserved.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Build the shared-membrane coupon and matched impermeable control using the strongest existing process; show a necessary new interface/material mechanism.

candidates.title: Passive single-exposure longwave infrared spectral cube
candidates.claim_scope: Quantitative 8–12 micrometre spatial spectra of a nonrepeatable event; submitted counterexample specifically tests 64 linear measurements of 192 unrestricted radiance bins.

novelty.reason: Separate prior components do not establish the complete stated wavelength/passivity/transient combination. Combining those components is not a demonstrated substantive advance, and an abstract-level gap is insufficient positive evidence.

usefulness.reason: A calibrated spectrum of a nonrepeatable event is a concrete laboratory outcome. No measured improvement over a conventional spectrometer is supplied.

feasibility.reason: Rank 64 with 192 unconstrained radiance variables prevents injective linear recovery; the positive-cube witness is valid for the supplied generic operator. It does not show that a real snapshot instrument cannot allocate more detector channels, trade spatial resolution, or exploit an independently justified scene class.
feasibility.scope: No physical optical operator, conversion efficiency, noise or photon-throughput model was tested.

commercial.reason: The assumed $45,000 sale minus $35,000 build/calibration and $5,000 support yields $5,000 before R&D. Useful performance, alignment/service costs and buyer demand are unobserved.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Provide a realizable forward operator with sufficient independent channels and a photon budget; then blind radiometric comparison.

candidates.title: Preservation of all streams in stretch-textile recycling
candidates.claim_scope: Dyed cotton/PET/elastane ternary feed with each polymer reusable, high molecular-weight retention and solvent cycling.

novelty.reason: Selective elastane recovery with synthetic hosts is already reported. The record does not establish that the cited DES process handles cotton or that sequential hydrolysis/glycolysis preserves intact polymer molecular weight. No new selectivity window is constructed.

usefulness.reason: Retaining elastane and host-polymer value is a clear recycler outcome; recycled-stream qualification and customer value are not measured.

feasibility.reason: No ternary mass balance, dye assay, molecular-weight distribution, tensile test or solvent-reuse experiment was performed. Existing binary or monomer-recycling results cannot validate the stronger preservation specification.

commercial.reason: The solvent sensitivity is correct: 5,000 kg solvent/t feed at $2/kg costs $100/t makeup at 1% loss and $300/t at 3%. This exposes fragility of the assumed $50/t contribution, but does not establish an actual operating margin.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Run the published processes on the exact ternary feed with polymer-chain and solvent-loop measurements; identify a mechanistic selectivity advance if they fail.

candidates.title: Waste fluorine into fluorination feedstock
candidates.claim_scope: Characterized concentrated fluorochemical waste transformed into usable fluoride reagent and then used in a specified synthesis.

novelty.reason: The cited primary work explicitly supplies waste destruction, fluoride recovery and fluorination reuse. Mixed-feed qualification requirements alone do not establish a new capability.

usefulness.reason: A reagent that works in a specified reaction plus destroyed waste is a concrete dual output; commercial quality assurance and demand are not demonstrated by this arm.

feasibility.reason: Primary retrieved material supports the central chemistry. The arm did not reproduce it or validate real-feed impurities, emissions and industrial qualification.

commercial.reason: The $0.214 per million litres bound is valid only for its stated concentration, fluorine fraction, KF price and perfect recovery assumptions. It rules out financing that dilute case through reagent revenue alone, not a gate-fee-supported concentrated-waste service.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Only reopen for a distinct chemical transformation or difficult feed regime requiring a demonstrated new principle, with closed fluorine balance.

candidates.title: Dry-storable regenerated cement binder
candidates.claim_scope: Recovered cement constituents become a storable water-activated binder through electrical regeneration, with no purchased reactive binder.

novelty.reason: Electrochemical recovery is already supplied; the proposed Ca(OH)2/reactive-silica construction is ordinary recovered pozzolanic binding. Retrieved C–S–H regeneration claims do not prove the exact dry-storage/strength target is occupied.

usefulness.reason: Reusing demolition fines as a qualified binder is concrete; the value over known recycling routes has not been measured.

feasibility.reason: A recovered hydrated phase is not automatically a dry-storable precursor that develops new binding strength. No energy balance, storage result or standardized mortar test was performed.

commercial.reason: The stated assumptions give 0.4375 MWh/t electricity break-even. They are sensitivity inputs, not measured energy or market prices; impurity rejection, certification and delivery remain unresolved.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Demonstrate a distinct reactive precursor or bonding mechanism against composition-matched lime/silica, then test real fines, storage and strength.

candidates.title: Clearance of a particular hidden region
candidates.claim_scope: Original narrative requests a particular hidden approach corridor/cell, admits abstention through an all-consistent-worlds rule, and asks for prespecified nonzero useful clearance coverage. The counterexample ROI is hidden cell 3.

novelty.reason: Feasible-set certification is established inverse-problem reasoning; no new physical observable or substantive measurement construction is supplied. Existing NLOS reconstructions do not by themselves establish the exact proposed safety output.

usefulness.reason: Reliable hidden-region clearance could affect robot motion; useful coverage and the operational cost of abstention are unmeasured.

feasibility.reason: At y=[3,3], scene [1,1,0] leaves ROI 3 empty and scene [0,0,3] occupies it. Thus that measurement cannot support a clear certificate for ROI 3. A sound all-worlds certifier may return unknown; this pair does not prove all useful abstaining certification impossible.
feasibility.scope: Both scenes occupy some region. With known strictly positive A and nonnegative radiance, whole-room x=0 versus x!=0 is distinguishable by y=0 versus y!=0 in this noiseless proxy model. Neither physical-room realizability nor nonzero coverage was tested.

commercial.reason: The record specifies a coherent module/service cost structure but supplies no prices, avoided-loss measurements, calibration burden or observed demand. Always-unknown output would provide no demonstrated value.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: Fix the physical ROI, optical model, noise and radiance/occupancy relationship; establish achievable clearance coverage and a substantive new observable.
candidates.correction_to_frozen_wording: Interpret the frozen phrase reject unconstrained guarantee only as rejection of an unsupported claimed capability, not a theorem that every clearance instrument or abstaining certificate is impossible.

candidates.title: Cyclic-switch depolarizing quantum transmission
candidates.claim_scope: Four completely depolarizing qubit channels with coherent cyclic-order control and the specified herald branch.

novelty.reason: The arm reproduces the identified theoretical construction and experimental target rather than providing a substantive advance.

usefulness.reason: A heralded entanglement-preserving channel is a concrete information-processing output, but no distributed-link or buyer benefit over resource-matched alternatives is shown.

feasibility.reason: The submitted Kraus construction gives the expected branch probability and negative Choi partial transpose. This supports one-shot heralded entanglement preservation in the ideal model, not loss-tolerant deployment or an unconstrained asymptotic-capacity claim.

commercial.reason: Channel/control/detector costs and success probability are included symbolically. Physical losses, coherent-control resources, alternative architectures, price and demand remain unmeasured.

candidates.next_decisive_evidence: A separately specified useful channel transformation beyond the known construction, with a complete resource-matched comparator; routine parameter changes do not suffice.

decision.comparison_claim: Both arms remain negative. No method-superiority, human-expert equivalence, statistical accuracy or opportunity-space-exhaustion conclusion is supported.
decision.reason: No submission establishes a substantive advance with adequately supported construction and commercial mechanism at its claimed useful-output scope.

scope_corrections.correction: The two scenes are both globally occupied. The counterexample concerns ROI 3, not whole-room vacancy. It also does not refute useful selective certification with abstention; broad clearance coverage remains unestablished.

A generic underdetermined 64-by-192 linear operator excludes unrestricted recovery under that sampling model. It is not a universal impossibility result for passive single-shot longwave spectral instruments.
The obstruction is common unknown writer-rate time reparameterization. It does not rule out physical clocks with independent calibration or observables.

Closed multimaterial cavities and chemically selective pressure-tight internal membranes are different useful outputs; the narrow membrane target is unbuilt, not demonstrated occupied by the cited cavity result alone.
A cotton/PET hydrolysis-glycolysis recycling route does not itself validate intact polymer preservation or 90% molecular-weight retention in a ternary blend.
Ambient C–S–H recovery does not alone establish the claimed dry-storable hydraulic product; absence of this evidence is not positive novelty.
The dilute-feed revenue calculation is a scenario-specific financing bound, not a general proof that PFAS recovery services are commercially impossible.
Heralded ideal-model entanglement preservation is not by itself a deterministic-link, asymptotic-capacity, or commercial superiority result.

amendment_timing.U: After all 12 searches and eight opens; before final records and probes
amendment_timing.E: After four searches; before final candidate commitment

protocol_limits.consequence: Asymmetric amendment timing is an additional exploratory comparison confound. Both had five blocked/challenged opens and only three substantive opens, limiting comparator depth.
protocol_limits.replication: One model session per arm; equal caps do not establish equal hidden computation.
protocol_limits.followup_boundary: quantum_followup.json is separate post-selection exploration and is not added to either arm score or selection evidence.
